name: diffusion
description: The Diffusion Studio editor inside the harness. Agents use the same commands; sign-in, generation, transcription and listen go through local adapters.

tools.name: diffusion.run
tools.description: Run one editor command in the open Diffusion tab: open, context, capture, check, export, probe, grab, transcribe, filmstrip, waveform, listen, fonts, logs, screenshot, window, job.

tools.name: diffusion.generate
tools.description: Generate media through the connected adapter. Without an address the call says nothing is connected.
